excluded_candidate_factor.name: COORDINATE_COMPATIBILITY
excluded_candidate_factor.reason: The bounded transfer unit is state/transaction/restoration mechanics and does not transfer Euclidean geometry or coordinate semantics.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Availability of an exact, versioned, content-addressed donor artifact and exact candidate transfer unit.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: Any required donor commit/path/blob/transfer-unit identity is unresolved or inconsistent.
admitted_factors.one_definition: All required donor commit/path/blob/transfer-unit identities are exact and mutually consistent.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Ability to isolate the candidate mechanics from donor object identity, taxonomy, containment, route meaning, standing, or domain semantics.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: The candidate mechanic cannot operate without importing one or more prohibited donor semantics.
admitted_factors.one_definition: The candidate mechanic can be specified and executed as destination-neutral mechanics with prohibited donor semantics stripped.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Availability of a bounded adapter mapping from candidate donor mechanics to the frozen Laws contextual state interface without changing destination authority semantics.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: At least one required destination interface operation has no bounded semantics-preserving mapping from the donor transfer unit.
admitted_factors.one_definition: Every required candidate transfer operation has a bounded mapping to the destination interface without modifying destination authority semantics.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Availability of all runtime dependencies required by the transferred mechanics without requiring prohibited donor semantic state.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: At least one required mechanical runtime dependency is unavailable or only satisfiable by importing prohibited donor semantics.
admitted_factors.one_definition: All required runtime dependencies are available directly or through bounded destination adapters without prohibited semantic import.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Ability of the bounded transfer to preserve the frozen contextual topology invariants, state separation, fail-closed behavior, and context-history authority.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: The candidate transfer necessarily violates at least one frozen topology/interface invariant.
admitted_factors.one_definition: All frozen topology/interface invariants can be preserved by the bounded transfer and adapter contract.

admitted_factors.semantic_definition: Ability to verify the transferred snapshot/transaction/restoration mechanics using predeclared observable checks without inferring success from visual state.
admitted_factors.zero_definition: One or more required transfer behaviors cannot be deterministically observed under a predeclared verification procedure.
admitted_factors.one_definition: All required transfer behaviors have deterministic nonvisual observables and predeclared verification procedures.
